lines.text: Hello, I'm Priya, one of the physios. What are you coming in with?
Pain on the outside of my right elbow, mainly when I grip the kettle.
How long has it been going on?
This flare is about six weeks old.
Anything in the past with that arm?
I had previous surgery on that elbow back in my twenties, if memory serves.
Actually, there's something else, it's much worse after a long day on the computer mouse.
Let me have a look. Squeeze my fingers as hard as you can.
Grip is noticeably weaker on the right, and pressing just below the bony point reproduces your pain.
I think what's going on is tennis elbow, though it could possibly be coming from your neck, so I'll check that next time.
Take the strain off by lifting the kettle with your palm facing up, and slowly lower a tin of beans with your wrist, fifteen times, twice a day.
I'm certain the mouse is the culprit, no question.
Could well be. Book in for two weeks.
